===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Freescale]] ([[NXP]]) P1020 Dual-core [[PowerPC]] @533MHz *Memory: 512MB (DDR3) SDRAM *Flash: 128MB (NAND), 2MB (NOR) *Network: 5x Gigabit Ethernet ports *USB: 2x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 3.33A via barrel
